//: CrysViz theme registry. Each theme is a directory under themes/ holding a theme.css (and optionally an icons/ folder). The loader (ui/ThemeManager.js) always applies `base` first, then the selected theme's `css` (null = base only). To add a theme: create themes/<id>/theme.css (+ icons if you want to override the defaults) and add one entry below. The special `auto` entry follows the OS prefers-color-scheme: its `auto` is [light-side theme, dark-side theme]; selecting it tracks the system, and the dark/twilight/light toggle reflects whichever is in effect.
